name: cortex
description: Local-first knowledge graph and RAG system

scripts.db:reset: npm run infra:nuke && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U cortex -d cortex
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: npm run go -- build ./... && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.lint: npm run go -- vet ./... && npm --prefix web run lint
